body:
Amara (S008) on DESKTOP-2VPR9IB (the operator's Windows box, TisoneK-Windows env block):
general sweep per the standing target — discovery + review + fix all safe issues, then report.

First item found at baseline: the pre-commit gate fails on this box with two Windows-only
errors in src/sites/betb2b/tests/test_betb2b_e2e_offline.py — fixture reads a JSON capture
with Path.read_text() without an encoding, which decodes as cp1252 here and raises
UnicodeDecodeError (byte 0x81 at position 3065). Pre-existing, not caused by this session;
documented in the session notes; fixing it (add encoding="utf-8", deep-scan for the same
unencoded-read pattern in test files) is the first safe fix.

Scope claimed: a review-and-fix sweep over the betb2b scraper/store, the security guard and
the browser profiles on this box — safe fixes with tests, architectural items flagged in the
review instead. No engine/ingest work (scraper only). Office is otherwise idle (no live peer
rows, no open collab session), so no worktree ceremony: work happens on main as the protocol
allows solo.
